title: Why an agent — or why not?

steps.claim: An agent is a loop that may call tools
steps.because: The model proposes the next action under uncertainty. That is different from a numbered procedure you already know.

steps.claim: If you can write a function, do that
steps.because: Microsoft Agent Framework’s own overview says a function or workflow wins when steps are known. An agent adds agency risk (OWASP LLM03).
A DAG or state machine is testable. A free loop is not a substitute for a refund playbook or a dbt test.

steps.claim: Tools need identity, not a system prompt
steps.because: Hidden context is discoverable (LLM08). Least privilege lives in the runtime that actually invokes the API.
